method: Regex source/config/dependency marker inventory of tracked baseline corpus, no execution or universal sink/taint analysis
boundaries: Only repository-owned source/config and its declared lockfile; not installed dependency source, native libraries or actual production configuration
A marker can occur in a comment or be a safe constant; not an exploit or complete sink inventory
Absence can justify conditional non-applicability for absent integrations, not a platform-wide security certification
Requalify if feature/config/dependency inventory changes; external support stack internals not audited here
